text: The perimeters of two similar triangles $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle DEF$ are $30\text{ cm}$ and $45\text{ cm}$. If the altitude $AL$ of $\triangle ABC$ is $6\text{ cm}$, the corresponding altitude $DM$ of $\triangle DEF$ is

Assertion (A): In $\triangle LMN$ and $\triangle XYZ$, $\angle M = \angle Y = 90^\circ$ and $\angle L = \angle X = 35^\circ$. Then $\triangle LMN \sim \triangle XYZ$.
Reason (R): If two angles of one triangle are respectively equal to two angles of another triangle, the two triangles are similar.
options: Both A and R are true and R explains A
Both A and R are true but R does not explain A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

text: $AP$ and $DQ$ are the medians of $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle DEF$ drawn to the sides $BC$ and $EF$ respectively. If $AC = 13\text{ cm}$, find $DF$.

If two sides and the median bisecting the third side of one triangle are respectively proportional to two sides and the corresponding median of another triangle, prove that the two triangles are similar. (Take $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle PQR$ with medians $AD$ and $PM$ to the sides $BC$ and $QR$, and $\frac{AB}{PQ} = \frac{AC}{PR} = \frac{AD}{PM}$.)

In $\triangle ABC$, $AB = 7\text{ cm}$, $AC = 9\text{ cm}$ and the median $AD$ to $BC$ is $7\text{ cm}$. In $\triangle PQR$, $PQ = 10.5\text{ cm}$, $PR = 13.5\text{ cm}$ and the median $PM$ to $QR$ is $10.5\text{ cm}$. Prove that $\triangle ABC \sim \triangle PQR$. If $BC = 8\text{ cm}$, find $QR$ and the ratio of the areas of the two triangles.

$\triangle PQR \sim \triangle STU$. $PA$ and $SB$ are medians of the two triangles, drawn to the sides $QR$ and $TU$. Prove that $\triangle PQA \sim \triangle STB$. If $PR = 9\text{ cm}$, $SU = 12\text{ cm}$ and $SB = 10\text{ cm}$, find the length of the median $PA$.
In $\triangle PQR$, $S$ is a point on the side $QR$ such that $\angle QPS = \angle PRQ$. Prove that $PQ^{2} = QS \times QR$.

text: Two vertical poles $AB = 10\text{ m}$ and $CD = 15\text{ m}$ stand on level ground with their feet $B$ and $D$ $20\text{ m}$ apart.
